player_prompt.intro:
Wobɛhwɛ {N} ahintaw a wɔayɛ no koko sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ.
Wɔ kwan biara no, ketɔ [accept] sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyi *nea ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren* no, anaasɛ [continue] sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyin no ma wohwɛ akyire no.
Sɛ wunkɔfa no da, wɔbɛma woyi nea ɛwɔ akyire no.
Wobɛdi nkunim (reward = 1) **nkutoo** sɛ nea woyi no yɛ nea ɛkorɔn sen nyinaa.

outcome.summary: Woyi {value} wɔ {draw_num}/{N} mu. Nea ɛkorɔn sen nyinaa no yɛ {best}. {result}
